name: prod-by-claude
description: Use when an agent needs to make a HyperFrames video of a Strudel live-coding track, where the code itself is the picture and every token lights up on the note it plays. Trigger on: "strudel video", "live coding video", "show my code playing", "make a video of this track with the code", "prod by claude". Covers composing the track, recording it offline from pinned Strudel, and building the 1080x1080 video (typed opener, parts powering on, real Strudel theme switches, graffiti ASCII drops, typed sign-off).
